title: Improved Regret Analysis in Gaussian Process Bandits: Optimality for Noiseless Reward, RKHS norm, and Non-Stationary Variance
summary: The SE cumulative-regret conclusion of Theorem6.3 is false on its stated variance domain. An allowed fixed sequence V_T=T^2-1/2 makes its claimed rate tend to0, although a legal two-point SE instance incurs a pathwise positive first-round regret. The central variance lemma's inspected good-index/determinant argument is sound.
page_convention: Internal printed pages1-31 equal physical PDF pages; not PMLR continuous pages.

problems.title: Theorem6.3's raw logarithmic SE rate is invalid on its stated nonstationary variance domain
problems.claim: Under Assumptions2.1-2.2, finite X and V_T=Omega(1), Algorithm3 satisfies R_T=O(log T sqrt[V_T log^{d+1}(T^2/V_T) log(|X|/delta)]) for SE kernel with probability>=1-delta.
problems.location: PDF p8 Theorem6.3; AppendixF.1 p23 (102)-(103), p24 (107)-(108); Algorithm3 p28
assumptions: d=1, X={0,1} compact finite, SE lengthscale1 and k(x,x)=1
Initial posterior variances both1; legal deterministic tie rule x1=0
Independent Gaussian epsilon_t with rho1^2=1/2 and rhot^2=2t-1 for t>=2
One fixed infinite positive variance sequence, V_T=T^2-1/2=Omega(1)
True deterministic variance proxy revealed after each step, satisfying information order
T^2/V_T>1 for allT, so logarithms strictly positive
problems.suspect_step: The information-gain asymptotic gamma_T((V_T/T)I)=O(log^{d+1}(T^2/V_T)) is used when T^2/V_T approaches1. The positive startup term is then absorbed into a vanishing expression.

check.actual: R_T >=1-exp(-1/2)=0.3934693402873666 for everyT and every noise outcome.
check.claimed: For d1, displayed rate factor F_T ~sqrt(log8)/2 *logT/T ->0.
check.consequence: No finite big-O constant makes theorem true for all sufficiently largeT; failure pathwise.
check.independent_source_step: Repeated identical query gives gamma_T((V_T/T)I)>=1/2 log(1+T^2/V_T)->1/2log2>0, while log^2(T^2/V_T)->0.

counterevidence: Nearby lower-bound Corollary6.1 explicitly imposes V_T=O(T^2) with sufficiently small constant, but upper Theorem6.3 does not inherit that assumption.
Low-noise prose may indicate intended narrower regime; adding restriction changes theorem.
No floored-log convention or added1 found in inspected definitions; source pages8,23,24 actually viewed.
Central Lemma3.1 and lower-noise/noiseless/Matern/RKHS results not refuted by this example.
problems.impact: Direct contradiction of a main nonstationary-variance guarantee and its actual information-gain derivation; Major under0.7.1. Scope restricted to missing high-variance domain; not entire paper failure.
